dialogues.speaker: Djembe Studios Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Here, we sell all kinds of instruments, from beginner kits to artisan works custom-crafted for your performances. Feel free to come and try them out!"

dialogues.speaker: Djembe Studios Advertisement
dialogues.text: "At the same, we hope that all music-loving customers have a basic estimation of the difficulty of learning their desired instrument and the time and effort required before making a purchase."

dialogues.speaker: Djembe Studios Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Practicing your instrument can be a long, lonely journey, but playing your instrument is one of the greatest experiences in the world."

dialogues.speaker: Djembe Studios Advertisement
dialogues.text: "May you find your true instrument love, may you give your musical learning journey all the time it needs, and may you shock the world someday!"
